risk.noTests: Changed code path has no direct test coverage in the brief; verify behavior manually or ask for coverage.
risk.noTypes: Changed code lacks useful type coverage; verify runtime safety and narrowing at the boundary.
risk.legacyArea: Chunk touches legacy-marked code; verify the change follows current patterns rather than entrenching the old one.
risk.denseLogic: Chunk contains branching or state-heavy logic; enumerate edge cases before signing off.
risk.touchesAuth: Authentication, authorization, session, or identity behavior changed; verify access boundaries explicitly.
risk.mutatesState: Chunk writes or invalidates persistent state; check ordering, idempotency, and rollback behavior.
risk.removesValidation: A guard or validation boundary changed; verify the newly accepted input space is intentional.
risk.relaxesPermissions: Permission scope may be broader; enumerate newly admitted actors and confirm intent.
risk.widensErrorHandling: Error handling became broader or quieter; verify correctness bugs cannot be hidden.
risk.addsFeatureFlag: Feature-flag behavior changed; check defaults, rollout plan, and cleanup obligation.
risk.newDependency: A new direct dependency entered a manifest; verify it earns its place — stdlib or an existing dep may cover it.
risk.newAbstraction: A new named abstraction was introduced; check whether an existing pattern or utility already covers it.
risk.commentContradictsCode: A comment and its adjacent code appear to disagree; read both and resolve which side is right.
risk.externalIo: Chunk reaches outside the process; verify timeout, retry, idempotency, and outage behavior.
risk.crossService: Chunk touches a contract consumed outside this app; check compatibility and migration expectations.
risk.schemaAdjacent: Chunk sits near persistence/schema assumptions; verify consistency with the data model.
risk.hotPath: Chunk lives on a high-traffic or latency-sensitive path; check allocations, sync I/O, and unbounded work.
risk.widelyImported: Changed API has broad call-site reach; enumerate consumers and contract impact.
risk.releaseImminent: Change appears close to release; verify revert and mitigation paths are clear.
